verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe one-step publishing: 'Publishing turns your Lovable project into a live web app by deploying a snapshot to a URL you can share' and 'Publishing takes two clicks, and the defaults work for most projects', with hosting handled automatically via Lovable Cloud (no infra setup). missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of the exact publish flow (community evidence discusses build quality/backend but not the publish step itself).
